normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize a Google Test JSON output object by replacing timestamps, times, and file paths with wildcards
normalize_test_failure_messages: normalize test failure messages by stripping line numbers and stack traces from Google Test JSON output
normalize_test_timestamps: normalize test timestamps and elapsed time values in Google Test JSON output to asterisks for deterministic comparison
normalize_test_file_paths: normalize file paths in Google Test JSON output by stripping directory prefixes to keep only basenames
normalize_nested_json_structure: recursively normalize nested dicts and lists in Google Test JSON output to remove transient run-specific data
